terms.definitionEn: A React Hook for synchronizing a component with an external system after a render has committed.
terms.definitionAr: Hook من React لمزامنة الـ component مع نظام خارجي بعد ما الـ render يتعمله commit.

terms.definitionEn: The function passed to useEffect that starts or performs synchronization for the committed render.
terms.definitionAr: الدالة اللي بتتبعت لـ useEffect وبتبدأ أو بتعمل المزامنة الخاصة بالـ render اللي اتعمله commit.

terms.definitionEn: The optional function returned by an Effect setup to stop or undo that synchronization.
terms.definitionAr: دالة اختيارية بترجعها دالة الـ Effect عشان توقف المزامنة أو تنظفها.

terms.definitionEn: The point when a component is first added to the rendered UI tree.
terms.definitionAr: اللحظة اللي الـ component بتتضاف فيها لأول مرة لشجرة الواجهة المعروضة.

terms.definitionEn: The point when a component is removed from the rendered UI tree, after which its active Effects are cleaned up.
terms.definitionAr: اللحظة اللي الـ component بتتشال فيها من شجرة الواجهة، وبعدها الـ Effects النشطة بتتنضف.

terms.definitionEn: The optional array of reactive values that tells React when an Effect must be synchronized again.
terms.definitionAr: الـ array الاختيارية اللي فيها القيم التفاعلية وبتحدد إمتى React تزامن الـ Effect من جديد.

terms.definitionEn: A value from component props, state, or its body that can differ between renders and may need to be listed as an Effect dependency.
terms.definitionAr: قيمة من props أو state أو جسم الـ component ممكن تختلف بين renders، وممكن يلزم إضافتها كـ dependency للـ Effect.

terms.definitionEn: React compares each dependency with its previous value using Object.is to decide whether to re-run an Effect.
terms.definitionAr: React بتقارن كل dependency بقيمتها السابقة باستخدام Object.is عشان تقرر تعيد تشغيل الـ Effect ولا لأ.

terms.definitionEn: Running an Effect's cleanup for its previous values and then its setup for the latest values when dependencies change.
terms.definitionAr: تشغيل cleanup بالقيم القديمة وبعدها setup بالقيم الجديدة لما الـ dependencies تتغير.

terms.definitionEn: A function created by an earlier render that continues to read the values captured by that render instead of newer values.
terms.definitionAr: دالة اتعملت في render أقدم ولسه بتقرأ القيم اللي اتسجلت وقتها بدل القيم الأحدث.

terms.definitionEn: The practice of declaring every reactive value used by an Effect so it stays synchronized with the values from the latest render.
terms.definitionAr: إنك تكتب كل قيمة تفاعلية الـ Effect بيستخدمها عشان يفضل متزامن مع قيم أحدث render.

terms.definitionEn: A repeated render-and-Effect cycle that can occur when an Effect updates state and that update changes a dependency without a stopping condition.
terms.definitionAr: دورة متكررة من render وEffect ممكن تحصل لما الـ Effect يغير state والتغيير ده يعدل dependency من غير شرط يوقفها.

questions.question: What is this Effect primarily doing?
options: Synchronizing the document title with the current title value
Creating a React state variable that stores the browser tab title
Changing the title prop so the parent receives the new string
Rendering a second component whenever the title value changes
questions.explanation: The Effect synchronizes the document title, an external browser system, with the current title value.
questions.explanationAr: الـ Effect بتزامن عنوان الصفحة، وده نظام خارجي عن React، مع قيمة title الحالية.

questions.question: What does the function passed to useEffect represent?
options: A render callback that must return the JSX for this component
The setup that synchronizes with the room after a commit
A state initializer that runs before React creates the UI
A cleanup handler that React calls only after unmounting
questions.explanation: The passed function is the Effect setup; it runs after a commit to synchronize with the current room.
questions.explanationAr: الدالة اللي اتبعتت هي setup بتاعة الـ Effect، وبتشتغل بعد الـ commit عشان تزامن الغرفة الحالية.

questions.question: What does the empty dependency array communicate?
options: The setup runs during every render before the UI is committed
No listed value change triggers re-synchronization
The Effect is removed from the component and never runs
React will run the setup exactly once in every development mode
questions.explanation: An empty array declares no reactive dependencies, so later prop or state changes do not by themselves trigger re-synchronization; development Strict Mode may perform an extra setup and cleanup check.
questions.explanationAr: الـ array الفاضية معناها مفيش dependencies تخلّي الـ Effect تعيد المزامنة مع تغييرات props أو state؛ وStrict Mode في التطوير ممكن يعمل setup وcleanup زيادة للاختبار.

questions.question: What is the returned function for?
options: It returns the next interval id as the component's rendered value
It prevents React from committing the component until the timer ends
It clears the timer during Effect cleanup, such as on unmount
It runs the interval callback before the setup function starts
questions.explanation: The returned function is cleanup; it clears the timer when this Effect is cleaned up, including when the component unmounts.
questions.explanationAr: الدالة الراجعة هي cleanup؛ بتوقف المؤقت لما الـ Effect تتنضف، ومن ضمن ده لما الـ component تتشال.

questions.question: How does React decide whether roomId changed for this Effect?
options: It compares the new and previous dependency with Object.is
It compares the text produced by converting both values to strings
It reruns the Effect after every render and ignores the array values
It compares the dependency array's object identity as a whole
questions.explanation: React compares each listed dependency with its previous value using Object.is.
questions.explanationAr: React بتقارن كل dependency بالقيمة السابقة بتاعتها باستخدام Object.is.

questions.question: Why might the event callback keep using an old status value?
options: React freezes all state values as soon as a component mounts
It captures status from the initial render
The browser event removes status from JavaScript after the first callback
Every listener created in an Effect automatically receives current props
questions.explanation: The callback closes over status from the render that created it, and an empty dependency list does not recreate it when status changes.
questions.explanationAr: الـ callback ماسكة قيمة status من الـ render اللي عملها، والـ array الفاضية مش هتخليها تتعمل من جديد لما status تتغير.

questions.question: What does React do when one listed dependency changes?
options: It changes the existing connection's fields without calling user code
It keeps every old connection active until the component unmounts
It cleans up before setting up with the new values
It skips cleanup because the dependency array is not empty
questions.explanation: When a dependency changes, React runs the previous cleanup before running setup with the latest dependency values.
questions.explanationAr: لما dependency تتغير، React بتشغل cleanup القديمة قبل setup بالقيم الجديدة.

questions.question: Why can this Effect keep triggering another render and setup?
options: A state setter is forbidden inside every Effect setup
React always adds one to every state value after rendering
The dependency array is copied into state on every commit
It changes its count dependency on every run
questions.explanation: Each setup updates count, causing a render with a changed count dependency and another setup, with no stopping condition.
questions.explanationAr: كل setup بتغير count، فبيحصل render والـ dependency تتغير تاني والـ setup تشتغل، من غير شرط يوقف الدورة.

questions.question: What is the dependency problem if draft can change between renders?
options: It reads draft but does not list it as a dependency
The cleanup must return draft so React can compare it with documentId
The documentId dependency disables the saveDraft function on updates
React only permits strings and numbers in dependency arrays
questions.explanation: Because the Effect reads draft from the component scope, draft is a reactive dependency and should be included unless the code is restructured.
questions.explanationAr: بما إن الـ Effect بتقرأ draft من جسم الـ component، فهي dependency تفاعلية ولازم تتضاف إلا لو غيرنا تنظيم الكود.

questions.question: What plain text does this component return in its JSX?
options: Loading
false
null
Ready
questions.explanation: The returned JSX contains the text Ready; updating document.title is a separate Effect synchronization.
questions.explanationAr: الـ JSX الراجعة فيها النص Ready؛ تحديث document.title مزامنة منفصلة في الـ Effect.

questions.question: What plain value is logged for this dependency comparison?
options: true
false
room-a
undefined
questions.explanation: Object.is returns true for these equal strings, so negating the result gives false.
questions.explanationAr: Object.is بترجع true للسلسلتين المتساويتين، وعكس النتيجة بـ ! بيدي false.

questions.question: What plain text does the JSX return when query is 'cats'?
options: document.title
Ready
cats
null
questions.explanation: The paragraph renders the query prop as text; the Effect separately synchronizes that value to the document title.
questions.explanationAr: الفقرة بتعرض prop اسمها query كنص؛ والـ Effect لوحدها بتزامن نفس القيمة مع عنوان الصفحة.

questions.prompt: Declare the reactive value used by this Effect.
questions.explanation: The Effect reads title from the component scope, so title belongs in its dependency array.
questions.explanationAr: الـ Effect بتقرأ title من جسم الـ component، فعشان كده title مكانها في dependency array.

questions.prompt: Use an empty dependency array because this setup reads no reactive values.
questions.explanation: The Effect uses only a literal value from outside the component, so it has no reactive dependencies to list.
questions.explanationAr: الـ Effect بتستخدم قيمة ثابتة ومش بتقرأ قيم تفاعلية من الـ component، فمفيش dependencies تتكتب.

questions.prompt: Remove the same listener function that setup registered.
questions.explanation: removeEventListener must receive the same function reference that was registered by addEventListener.
questions.explanationAr: removeEventListener لازم تاخد نفس مرجع الدالة اللي اتسجلت مع addEventListener.

questions.prompt: Declare the reactive room identifier used to create this connection.
questions.explanation: Changing roomId should clean up the previous connection and set up one for the new room.
questions.explanationAr: لما roomId تتغير، لازم الاتصال القديم يتنضف ويتعمل اتصال للغرفة الجديدة.

questions.prompt: Cancel the pending timer during cleanup.
questions.explanation: Clearing the timeout prevents the scheduled callback from running after the Effect no longer needs it.
questions.explanationAr: إلغاء الـ timeout بيمنع الـ callback المجدولة من الشغل بعد ما الـ Effect ماتحتاجهاش.

questions.prompt: Stop the old socket connection during Effect cleanup.
questions.explanation: The returned cleanup disconnects the socket before synchronization changes or when the component unmounts.
questions.explanationAr: الـ cleanup الراجعة بتفصل الـ socket قبل ما المزامنة تتغير أو لما الـ component تتشال.

questions.prompt: Cancel the request associated with an outdated URL or unmounted component.
questions.explanation: Aborting in cleanup stops work for the old URL when the dependency changes or the component is removed.
questions.explanationAr: إلغاء الطلب في cleanup بيوقف شغل الـ URL القديم لما dependency تتغير أو الـ component تتشال.

questions.prompt: Track count so the guarded update stops once it reaches three.
questions.explanation: Including count keeps the Effect synchronized with the value it reads; the guard prevents further updates at three.
questions.explanationAr: إضافة count بتخلي الـ Effect متزامنة مع القيمة اللي بتقراها؛ والشرط بيوقف التحديث لما توصل لتلاتة.

questions.question: What problem is useEffect intended to solve, and when does its setup run?
keyPoints: Synchronizes a component with an external system
Runs setup after a render has committed on the client
It is not a general replacement for event handlers
questions.modelAnswer: useEffect is for synchronizing a component with an external system, such as a browser API, subscription, or connection. React runs its setup after a render commits on the client, while rendering itself should remain pure.
questions.explanation: Effects connect committed UI to systems outside React rather than calculating the UI itself.
questions.explanationAr: الـ Effects بتوصل الواجهة بعد الـ commit بأنظمة بره React، مش بتحسب الواجهة نفسها.

questions.question: How should you choose the dependencies for an Effect?
keyPoints: Include every reactive value read by the Effect
Dependencies describe synchronization inputs, not a run-count preference
Restructure code when a dependency causes unwanted resynchronization
questions.modelAnswer: Include every reactive prop, state value, or component-body value that the Effect reads. React compares each dependency with its previous value using Object.is, so restructure the synchronization if an unwanted dependency change causes unnecessary work rather than omitting a value to control run counts.
questions.explanation: Complete dependencies keep the Effect aligned with the latest values it uses.
questions.explanationAr: الـ dependencies الكاملة بتخلي الـ Effect ماشية مع أحدث القيم اللي بتستخدمها.

questions.question: When does an Effect cleanup run, and what work is it commonly used for?
keyPoints: Before setup runs again with changed dependencies
To undo subscriptions, listeners, timers, or connections
Development Strict Mode may run an extra setup-cleanup check
questions.modelAnswer: Cleanup runs before the Effect sets up again with changed dependencies and when the component unmounts. It commonly removes a listener, clears a timer, disconnects a subscription, or aborts work; development Strict Mode can also check an Effect with an extra setup-cleanup cycle.
questions.explanation: Cleanup mirrors the external work started by setup and prevents obsolete synchronization from remaining active.
questions.explanationAr: الـ cleanup بتعكس الشغل الخارجي اللي بدأته setup وبتمنع استمرار مزامنة قديمة.

questions.sourceSection: Stale values and infinite effect loops
questions.question: How can missing dependencies and state updates inside an Effect cause bugs?
keyPoints: A missing dependency can leave a closure reading an old value
A state update can trigger another render and Effect
A changed dependency can repeat the cycle
Include dependencies and add a real stopping condition or restructure
questions.modelAnswer: If an Effect omits a reactive value, its closure can keep reading the value from an older render. If setup updates state and that update changes one of its dependencies, the next render can trigger setup again; include the dependencies and use a real stopping condition or restructure the synchronization.
questions.explanation: Fresh dependency values prevent stale closures, while guarded updates or a different design prevent feedback loops.
questions.explanationAr: الـ dependencies الصح بتمنع القيم القديمة، والشرط اللي بيوقف التحديث أو تغيير التصميم بيمنع الدورات المتكررة.
